document_metadata.document_title: Technical Guidance Manual for the Implementation of the Watershed Management Ordinance

design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: Volume control storage equals one (1) inch of stormwater runoff from newly developed impervious surfaces, treated using retention-based volume control practices first, then flow-through practices for any untreated portion. Site detention release rate must not exceed existing runoff rate (or calculated allowable release rate, whichever is smaller). Volume control storage may credit against required site detention volume.
peak_flow_calculation_method: Existing vs proposed runoff comparison (no increase)
Site detention with allowable release rate
Curve number method (CN tables in TGM)
approved_bmp_categories: Flow-through practices (vegetated swales, filter strips, oil/grit separators)
